fields.source_first_note: Read all571 characters. Ashath supplies the Kinda delegation encounter, his status in it, the lineage question and actual reply. A transmitter then separately reports Ashath habitual conditional saying about someone denying a Qurashi lineage. Keep that later Companion statement distinct from the original encounter and Prophet reply, under Ashath actual voice rather than Prophetic attribution. The conditional threatened action is not reported as already carried out. All source words and names remain exact.

Read all516 characters independently. The own Urdu contains a finite delegation report and a separate later used-to-say conditional Ashath judgement. Preserve the source superiority assessment and both negatives in the reply. Do not collapse the later statement into Prophet speech, infer an actual punishment, or import genealogy beyond the supplied words.

Read all2030 characters in full. Abu Said explicitly testifies to hearing/remembering the supplied99-then100 killings/repentance narrative. Preserve wrongful-killing qualifiers, the first respondent actual interjection and question predicates, the sinful-settlement circumstance, every mercy/judgement/Iblis clause and all actual numbers. Hammam/Humayd/Bakr is a route, followed by a finite source-named Abu Rafi adjudicating-angel addition; keep that supplied addition distinctly attributed, without inventing its ultimate speaker. Qatadah then relays Hasan Basri finite approaching-death movement/outcome addition, not Hasan eyewitness testimony. Both additions concern this same supplied story family. Retain their actual when-dispute trigger, adjudication purpose and measure-distance imperative; these are finite source qualifications, not lexical substitutions.

Read all1979 characters in full independently. The initial Abu Said hearing testimony introduces the complete99/100 repentance story. Retain every actual condition and utterance, including parenthetical wrongful-action qualifications, respondent question predicates, the sinful-village relation and the Urdu-only mercy-deserving conclusion in the reported angels response; do not supply it to Hindi. The Hammam/Humayd/Bakr prefatory route is context, but Abu Rafi actual adjudication addition and Qatadah/Hasan actual near-death movement version remain separately typed transmitted components in the same family, with no unsupplied ultimate speaker or eyewitness status. Their temporal/purpose and measure-distance clauses remain literal. Only the two Urdu footnote markers are apparatus within these bodies.
